HISD Icon Set

Material Symbols Rounded, filled (FILL 1), weight 500, on a 24px grid — vendored from google/material-design-icons. Every glyph paints with currentColor, so it inherits the --color-* token of whatever element it sits in and recolors automatically in dark mode.

0 icons

One glyph, every context color

The same school source, recolored only by the token on its container.

Icons live at .skills/design/hisd-brand-designer/assets/icons/*.svg and are listed in manifest.json. Add more with python3 scripts/pull_material_icons.py add <name>. Usage, sizing, and accessibility notes are in README.md.
